You can sometimes get bees while harvesting [[bee hive]]s or [[Beekeeping|wild hives]] for [[honey]], but only if you have unlocked the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|insects]] technology. They can also be bought for quite a high price from the [[beekeeper]] in the [[village]].

Bees are needed for setting up an [[apiary]] or can be decomposed in the [[Alchemy Lab|alchemy laboratory]].
